A fixture of T-480: the answer of the script of podssh health in a container
run with --cpus 4 --memory 4g on cgroup v1, whose hierarchies the engine
mounts with the container's own cgroup at their roots, on a host of 16 CPUs
and 62.8 GiB; written by hand in the forms of the kernel's cgroup-v1
memory.rst and cpusets.rst and of sched-bwc.rst, not captured. The main
session captures one on a host of cgroup v1 (T-480's Done).
